panels.title: Daemon Uptime (s)
panels.description: Seconds since process start. A sudden reset to 0 means the daemon crashed and restarted.

panels.title: SQLite Size (MB)
panels.description: Total size of telemetry.db + WAL/SHM. Should plateau once 14-day pruning kicks in.

panels.title: Queue Depth (Backpressure)
panels.description: Events waiting in memory for the 5s SQLite flush. Growing unbounded means disk writes are falling behind.

panels.title: Seconds Since Last Eval (Heartbeat)
panels.description: Freshness check: time() - last_eval_ts. If > 120s, the evaluator loop is stalled.

panels.title: RED — Rate: Events Flushed / sec by Table
panels.description: Shows per-collector throughput. If raw_keystrokes drops to 0 while typing, macOS Accessibility permission may be missing.

panels.title: RED — Duration: DB Flush & Eval Query Latency (ms)
panels.description: Tracks how fast SQLite writes and 14-day rolling queries run. Spikes indicate lock contention or missing indexes.

panels.title: RED — Errors: Runtime Errors by Component (5m)
panels.description: Non-zero values mean an exception occurred in the writer or evaluator thread.

panels.title: Baseline Days Collected (Alerts Unlock at 7d)
panels.description: Distinct calendar days in fatigue_log. Cluster alerts stay locked until >= 7 days are collected.

panels.title: Active App Anchor Warm-Up (0-100%)
panels.description: Progress toward 60 valid evaluations (~1h) needed to unlock per-app drift in the active window.
